title: King Ahasuerus' Feast and the Deposition of Queen Vashti
description: King Ahasuerus holds a great feast in the citadel of Susa, but becomes furious when Queen Vashti refuses to appear before his guests. Memukan and the advisors suggest that she be deposed to maintain order in the kingdom, and the king sends letters stating that every man should be master in his own house.
